description.en: Agent-agnostic skill that catalogs task input files into reusable Markdown structural explanations and a per-task SQLite search index. Supports 30+ formats — delimited tables with automatic delimiter detection, Excel, Parquet/Feather, JSON/YAML/TOML, SQLite, ZIP/TAR/GZIP, XML/HTML, Jupyter notebooks, Stata, RDS/RData, PDF, DOCX, images — plus source-structure extraction for 20+ programming languages. Works with OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, and DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 平台无关的 Agent 技能：把任务输入文件的结构（列、键、工作表、表、标签、归档成员、行数等）生成可复用的 Markdown 说明与任务本地 SQLite 索引。支持 30+ 种格式——自动探测分隔符的表格、Excel、Parquet/Feather、JSON/YAML/TOML、SQLite、ZIP/TAR/GZIP、XML/HTML、Jupyter notebook、Stata、RDS/RData、PDF、DOCX、图片——并为 20+ 种编程语言提取代码结构。兼容 OpenAI Codex、Claude Code 与 DeepSeek Harness。
